description: Team 通常表示一群為共同目標而合作的人，但近義詞會改變組織形式、任務性質和語域。 例如 group 只需表示一群人，squad 偏小型正式隊伍，crew 偏實務操作，unit 偏正式組織編制，task force / working group / project team 則各有明確任務結構。

options.explanation: Group ✓ — means a number of people considered together, whether formally organised or not. Here, the sentence treats the people as a collection rather than stressing coordinated performance. That makes Group the most precise replacement for this particular sense of team.

Squad — means a small organised team, especially in sport, policing, military or emergency contexts. This is narrower and usually implies a selected or formally organised small team, especially in sport, police, military or rescue contexts. The decisive clue is that the sentence treats the people as a collection rather than stressing coordinated performance.

Crew — means a team working together on a vehicle, vessel, production or practical operation. This is occupational and operation-focused, so it is not the best choice for general office, policy, or academic teamwork. The decisive clue is that the sentence treats the people as a collection rather than stressing coordinated performance.

Crowd — means a collection of people gathered together without necessarily having a shared task. A crowd need not share a goal, structure or cooperative task. The decisive clue is that the sentence treats the people as a collection rather than stressing coordinated performance.

Staff — means the employees of an organisation or workplace. Staff refers to employees collectively and does not necessarily mean they function as one team. The decisive clue is that the sentence treats the people as a collection rather than stressing coordinated performance.

Department — means an organisational division that may contain several teams. A department is an organisational division and may contain several separate teams. The decisive clue is that the sentence treats the people as a collection rather than stressing coordinated performance.
